definitions.explanation: The color green. Also refers to greenery, foliage, or verdure in nature.

examples.japanese: {緑|みどり}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{木|き}→木：00524_ki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦たくさん→たくさん：00597_takusan⟧⟦あります→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.notes: Using の to modify a noun

examples.japanese: ⟦{公園|こうえん}→公園：00581_kouen⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{緑|みどり}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いっぱい→一杯：01793_ippai⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: The park is full of greenery.
It's the person wearing green clothes.

examples.japanese: {緑|みどり}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ペン→ペン：02960_pen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}って→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦{窓|まど}→窓：02254_mado⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{見|み}える→見える：01165_mieru⟧{緑|みどり}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧⟦{気持|きも}ちいい→気持ちいい：09583_kimochiii⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: The greenery visible from the window is very pleasant.

notes: {緑|みどり} is a noun, so to modify another noun, you use {緑|みどり}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ (midori no). Interestingly, in traditional Japanese, the word ⟦{青|あお}→青：02841_ao⟧ (blue) covered both blue and green colors. Even today, green traffic lights and green vegetables are often called ⟦{青|あお}→青：02841_ao⟧. The distinct word {緑|みどり} for green became more common with Western influence.
